answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity with peer-audited slashing. Each agent locks a refundable deposit, and to transact it must collect attestations from a random panel of established peers. Sybils fan out like water through karst fissures, yet every clone draws from one shared lagoon of capital, so splitting a bond across many fakes thins each below the slashing floor. Honest peers echo a duplicate flag, the panel burns the bond, and the attacker cost scales with each identity while yield stays flat.
